Class CombatZone

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.CombatZone
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CombatZone extends Card
Represents a Combat Zone card that introduces one or more competitive challenges among all players. The player with the weakest performance in each challenge receives a corresponding penalty.
